test_dataset: test that every puzzle in the PushWorld benchmark dataset has a valid solution
run_get_puzzle_file_paths: run get_puzzle_file_paths to retrieve a map of puzzle names to file paths
use_PushWorldPuzzle_is_valid_plan: use PushWorldPuzzle.is_valid_plan to check if a sequence of actions solves a puzzle
use_PushWorldPuzzle_get_next_state: use PushWorldPuzzle.get_next_state to compute the next state after performing an action
use_PushWorldPuzzle_is_goal_state: use PushWorldPuzzle.is_goal_state to check if a state satisfies the puzzle goal
